title: Sign up
description: Full-viewport sign-up screen composing the login-form block in its sign-up mode: full name, email, a new password and the consent box, with the reasons to create an account beside the card. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across all three contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm, the footer at @md, and the highlights move beside the card at @lg.
